name: Cheese Curds

notToBeConfusedWith.name: Cheddar
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Curds are the fresh, unaged, unpressed form of the same style of cheese — springy and mild rather than firm and sharp, and they squeak faintly against the teeth when truly fresh.

animalOriginNote: Rennet type varies by producer, animal or microbial, so whether a given cheese is vegetarian depends on its label.

forms.label: Fresh
forms.sourceNote: USDA has no record for fresh cheese curds. This is its record for cheddar, the same style of cheese before curds are aged and pressed into a block; fresh curds are somewhat milder and lower in sodium than mature cheddar, but the fat and protein profile is closely comparable.
